newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia stocks end higher, led by Bavaria.
newsitem.headline: Colombia stocks end higher, led by Bavaria.

text.p: Colombian stocks closed slightly higher on Wednesday, led for the second consecutive day by demand for Bavaria, the leading brewer.

Medellin's IBOMED general price index closed 0.16 percent higher at 18,161.50 on volume of 4.2 billion pesos. Bogota's IBB price index finished 0.18 percent ahead at 1,193.69 on volume of 3.4 billion pesos.
Bavaria benefited from expectations of solid second-quarter results, brokers said. The company, the flagship of Julio Santo Domingo's financial empire, closed up 1.1 percent at 8,150 pesos.
About 1.9 billion pesos worth of Bavaria shares changed hands in Bogota and 747 million pesos worth in Medellin.

The brewer is set to complete a $146 million deal to sell a 55 percent share in Bancoquia, now called Banco Santander, to Santander de Espana in a trade expected to take place by the end of the month.
Cementos del Caribe rose 0.32 perent to 6,200 on volume of 113 million pesos in Bogota. In Medellin, the shares were up 0.80 percent to 6,250 on trading worth 54 million pesos.
Banco Industrial Colombiano jumped 3.19 percent to 3,752 pesos on volume of 767 million pesos in Bogota. It rose 1.23 percent at 3,766 on volume of 106 million pesos in Medellin.
